issues.description: Wrong screen displayed - showing step-1 room selection instead of step-3b style blend confirmation. The URL is /design/step-2 but the screenshot shows step-1 content. The expected step-3b screen with percentage bars for styles like Scandinavian/Japandi is not visible at all.
issues.root_cause: The screenshot appears to be captured at the wrong URL or the navigation is broken. The current screen being evaluated is step-3b but the screenshot shows the room picker (step-1). This may be a routing issue where step-3b redirects back to step-1 due to missing state.

issues.description: Hydration error in step-3 page: Prop 'style' width mismatch between server (5%) and client (15%). This causes the entire root to switch to client rendering and multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors.
issues.element: Progress bar width style in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, a percentage bar's width is computed dynamically (likely using Math.random() or Date-based logic, or reading from localStorage/sessionStorage) during SSR vs client render, producing different values: server renders 5%, client renders 15%.

issues.description: Step-3b page mounts (confirmed by console log event page:mount step-3b) but style names may be showing COVA* internal keys instead of human-readable names. The console shows the hydration issue originates in step-3 not step-3b, suggesting step-3b inherits broken state.
issues.element: Style name labels in step-3b percentage bars
issues.root_cause: Style lookup map in step-3b/page.tsx likely uses raw internal keys without a display name mapping.

fixes.reason: Suppresses the server/client width mismatch hydration warning caused by dynamic percentage calculation differing between SSR and client render.
